subject: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex (commit reshuffle proposal)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@teravex.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@teravex.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex

Hi Sofia,

We're coming up on our contract renewal and want to discuss two items that are blocking an internal go/no-go: a) Teravex needs to double our Dedicated capacity baseline for 2027 due to product launch timelines, and b) we need predictable unit economics as traffic ramps.

High level ask: 24-month term starting Jan 1, 2027; immediate 2x baseline capacity for first 3 months; a 12- to 18-month price hold on base rates; and either a 20-30% introductory discount or an equivalent credit pool to offset the first quarter's overage risk.

We're willing to commit to a higher overall ARR if we can get clear convertibility of unused committed capacity into credits and stronger guarantees for latency. Also need SOC 2 evidence packet and audit window dates (Priya is handling procurement). Can you send an approach/term sheet?

Thanks,
Liam
CTO, Teravex Systems
[Attachment: Teravex_Renewal_Rundown.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@teravex.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@teravex.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex

Hi Liam / Priya,

Appreciate the clear asks — congratulations on the launch prep. I've drafted a practical path that balances your need for predictability with Redwood's capacity planning. Attached is a proposal PDF and a short MAP (mutual action plan). Key points: 

- Term: 24 months (Jan 1, 2027 - Dec 31, 2028)
- Capacity: Immediate 2x baseline for the first 90 days funded against a committed pool; after 90 days, baseline reverts but burst capacity remains available per tiers.
- Price hold: 12 months guaranteed on the base per-token rates; automatic re-evaluation at month 13 against usage bands.
- Bespoke credit framework: committed spend split into two buckets — "steady" (long-term baseline) and "burst" (on-demand). Unused steady capacity converts to credits at 60% of paid value, usable against burst or future committed invoices.
- Introductory concession: additional one-time credit equal to 8% of year-1 committed spend if you sign the MAP within 10 business days.

Operational & compliance notes: we'll include SOC 2 packets with the SOW and set a 30-day window for evidence delivery. Latency SLOs will be covered under the Dedicated SLA; if you need tighter percentile targets we can scope the effort.

I've looped Ben (pricing) and Marissa (legal/AM) to confirm conversion rate and SOW language. If this matches your expectations, let's schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to finalize the MAP and DocuSign path.

Attachments: Redwood_Teravex_Commit_Proposal_20261130.pdf, MAP_Teravex_20261130.xlsx

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: Redwood_Teravex_Commit_Proposal_20261130.pdf (pdf); MAP_Teravex_20261130.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@teravex.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@teravex.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex

Sofia — thanks for the quick turn. A couple points from procurement:

1) The 60% convertibility of unused steady capacity is a good start, but procurement wants 70% for the first 12 months given our forecast uncertainty.
2) We'd like the price hold extended to 18 months. If Redwood can do 18 months + 70% conversion for year 1, we'll accelerate internal approvals and can sign within the 10 business-day window.
3) SOC 2 evidence and a clear audit scope are mandatory — can you confirm the dates you can deliver?

Liam, copying you so you see the commercial asks. Happy to discuss on the call.

- Priya
Head of Procurement, Teravex Systems

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex — need pricing/legal OK

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Teravex's counterpoints. They want: 70% convertibility of unused steady capacity for year 1 and an 18-month price hold. They will sign quickly if we can accept.

Commercial context: this is a shift from their current $420k ARR to ~ $1.1M ARR on the new commit profile (they're adding new product lines). Net margin impact is modest if we keep conversion at 60%, but at 70% the carry cost to Redwood increases by approximately $45k in year 1 (quick estimate). I recommend: accept 70% convertibility for year 1 only, maintain the intro credit (8%) as proposed, and hold price for 18 months but with a clause to reopen pricing if their monthly avg token consumption exceeds the top burst band for 3 consecutive months.

Legal asks: Marissa — can you confirm SOW language changes (convertibility mechanics + MAP acceptance triggers) and whether Finance needs a different invoicing cadence for the credit bucket?

If we agree, I will send the updated PDF and a DocuSign path. Time pressure — they indicated signing if we accept.

Thanks,
Sofia

[Internal note: deal_id RDW-TRX-2026-045; expected ARR uplift if signed: +$680k first year incremental. Please respond with approvals or redlines by EOD.]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex — need pricing/legal OK

Sofia / Marissa — finance signs off on 70% convertibility for year 1 conditional on: (a) the conversion is capped to the unused steady bucket for that contract year only (no multi-year carry), and (b) credits expire at the end of the 24-month term if unused. Approve the 18-month price hold with the reopen clause Ben suggested (3-month sustained overage triggers repricing discussion).

Marissa, legal to confirm: add a short schedule describing conversion calculation (hours/token equivalence and valuation at 70%) and the DocuSign acceptance triggers. Once you give the green light on SOW wording I'll ask Ops to prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Approve from finance.

-Ben
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@teravex.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@teravex.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity Expansion - Teravex (commit reshuffle proposal)

Sofia / team — thank you. We reviewed the updated proposal and the MAP. The 70% convertibility in year 1 and the 18-month price hold with the 3-month reopen clause are acceptable. SOC 2 packet timing is fine (we've scheduled the audit window for Q1). We'll sign the DocuSign this afternoon and route the PO to you as soon as it's approved.

Next steps:
- Sofia to send final DocuSign link and SOW (with conversion schedule)
- Redwood to deliver SOC 2 evidence pack within 30 days of signature
- Kickoff for Dedicated capacity adjustment on Jan 3, 2027

Appreciate the willingness to structure the convertibility mechanics — excited to scale with Redwood.

Regards,
Liam
CTO, Teravex Systems
